title: Meta-label sizing for ENTRY: scale size by a second model's confidence instead of a fixed tau cut

frontier.baseline: flat-size tau=0.1 policy on the same decisions, net of the full cost stack
frontier.consumer: ml_entry sizing on bybit_2 (Tier-3 change if it passes; the unit changes nothing)
frontier.next_step: dropped (power + already covered): per-trade sd 1.09 R (audit); concentrating Foxhound-1's 907 held-out decisions into a top half (n~450) gives se ~0.051 R, so the 80%-power MDE is ~0.14 R above the pooled +0.037 R (top half would need ~+0.18 R). The tau sweep in ml_decision_entry (TAU_GRID 0..0.30, chosen on dev folds) already tests 'trade only the high-confidence decisions'. Re-open only if RESID-ENTRY passes or on a pooled population >= ~3,000 decisions.
frontier.source: Lopez de Prado, Advances in Financial Machine Learning ch.3 meta-labelling (PRIMARY, book); conformal history in ml-plan-items (INDETERMINATE, PASS, FAIL)
frontier.why: Foxhound-1's edge is +0.037R/decision; per the audit it cannot be verified live at that size. Concentrating size on the top-confidence decisions raises per-trade edge, which is the only route to a verifiable edge on the small real-money book
